title: Multiple View Geometry in Computer Vision (2nd Edition)
annotation: The canonical 'bible' of geometric computer vision: covering projective transformations, the normalized 8-point algorithm, Sampson error, DLT triangulation, and bundle adjustment.

title: An Invitation to 3-D Vision: From Images to Geometric Models
authors: Yi Ma, Stefano Soatto, Jana Kosecka, S. Shankar Sastry
annotation: Rigorous treatment of multi-view geometry through Lie group perspectives, continuous epipolar kinematics, and rank constraints on multiple images.

title: Bundle Adjustment — A Modern Synthesis
authors: Bill Triggs, Philip F. McLauchlan, Richard I. Hartley, Andrew W. Fitzgibbon
publisher: Vision Algorithms: Theory and Practice (Springer LNCS)
annotation: Foundational survey establishing sparse Schur complement trick, gauge freedom, Levenberg-Marquardt damping, and photogrammetric network optimization.

title: COLMAP: Structure-from-Motion Revisited
publisher: IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)
annotation: Pioneering modern open-source Structure-from-Motion pipeline, demonstrating robust geometric correspondence verification, view selection, and scalable BA.
